title: The reset loop
note: Minimal-Story fuer Prop-Firm-Trader. Kein Produkt-Screenshot, keine Ergebnisversprechen - der Schmerz ist die Reset-Schleife und der dabei geloeschte Track Record. Zahlen sind Beispielrechnung (6 Evaluations a 299 USD = 1.794 USD gegen einen Payout von 412 USD).
caption:
Six evaluations. One payout. You are net negative to a firm you have never traded a live dollar for.

And the worse part isn't the money. Every failed account gets closed, and the trade history goes with it. Two years in, there is no file anywhere that says what your setup actually does over 400 trades — only receipts.

The account belongs to the firm. The record has to belong to you.

Figures are an illustrative example, not real results.
